concepts.label: SQL injection
concepts.description: Untrusted values improperly assembled into SQL statements may change query semantics.

concepts.label: Cross-site scripting
concepts.description: Untrusted content rendered in browser execution contexts may execute unwanted code.

concepts.label: Cross-site request forgery
concepts.description: A user browser can be induced to submit an unintended authenticated request.

concepts.label: Server-side request forgery
concepts.description: Untrusted URL inputs can cause a server to contact unintended network targets.

concepts.label: Path traversal
concepts.description: Improper path validation can allow access outside the intended root directory.

concepts.label: Command injection
concepts.description: Passing untrusted text into shell commands may allow unintended command execution.

concepts.label: Broken authorization
concepts.description: Insufficient authorization checks can expose cross-user or cross-tenant resources.

concepts.label: Secret handling
concepts.description: Sensitive credentials should be protected against logs, source commits and unauthorized reads.

concepts.label: Race condition
concepts.description: Concurrent operations on shared state can produce incorrect behavior when not synchronized.

concepts.label: Deadlock
concepts.description: Mutually waiting tasks may block progress when locks or resources form a cycle.

concepts.label: Memory safety
concepts.description: Memory lifetime and bounds errors include use-after-free, buffer overflows and invalid access.

concepts.label: Unit test isolation
concepts.description: Unit tests focus on an isolated behavior using controlled inputs and dependencies.

concepts.label: Integration testing
concepts.description: Integration tests validate behavior across component boundaries and real integrations.

concepts.label: Contract testing
concepts.description: Consumer/provider contract tests verify interface expectations across service boundaries.

concepts.label: Property-based testing
concepts.description: Property-based tests generate many inputs to check general invariants.

concepts.label: Fuzz testing
concepts.description: Fuzzing generates varied or malformed inputs to uncover crashes and unexpected behavior.

concepts.label: Mutation testing
concepts.description: Mutation testing changes code to evaluate whether the test suite detects altered behavior.

concepts.label: Test coverage
concepts.description: Coverage reports which lines, branches or conditions were executed by tests.

concepts.label: Taint analysis
concepts.description: Taint tracking follows untrusted data from sources through transformations to sinks.

concepts.label: Static application security testing
concepts.description: Static security analysis inspects source or binaries without executing the program.
